'''Amadaine 14 (June 22)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - At night, [[Rand]]'s party finds [[Padan Fain|Fain's]] camp, and steals back the [[Horn of Valere|Horn]] and the [[ruby-hilted dagger|dagger]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Perrin]] wakes to find [[Loial]] and [[Gaul]] have gone off to close the [[Waygate]]. [[Emond's Field]] is attacked by a force of five hundred [[Trolloc]]s. The Trollocs are defeated. The [[Tinkers]] arrive at Emond's Field; [[Aram]] asks to be taught the sword. [[Dain Bornhald|Bornhald]] and his [[Whitecloaks]] attempt to arrest Perrin.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Elayne]] meets with [[Egwene]] and [[Amys]] in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.
